name: turnery
description: Build parametric CAD parts with the Turnery desktop app over MCP: a feature tree you can read and change, requirements the kernel re-measures, STEP/STL export. Needs Turnery.app installed (macOS).

interface.longDescription: Turnery is a desktop CAD app with an MCP server. The agent builds parts as a feature tree (sketches, extrusions, fillets, holes, patterns, assemblies) and an OpenCascade kernel computes the geometry while you watch in a 3D window, drag parameters and pin notes on faces. Dimensions you state become checks the kernel re-measures on every rebuild. Export STEP, STL, 3MF, PNG or patent-style SVG line drawings. Needs Turnery.app on macOS; the MCP server runs locally and calls no model.
defaultPrompt: Use Turnery to build a 60x40x25 mm box with 2 mm walls and M3 screw holes in the corners
Use Turnery to make an enclosure for a Raspberry Pi Pico that prints without supports
